Zak

Also known as: At-Zako

The Chosen of Gipath

Zak is the protagonist of Cursed Lands. With no memory of his past, he reaches Gipath’s only human village, where Erfar the Silvertongue declares him the Chosen. The title makes him the settlement’s supposed protector and gives its leaders a convenient reason to send him into danger. Zak’s own purpose is to discover who he is. [1, 2, 3]

The search for the magician

Estera recognises that something unusual lies behind his lost memory. Her knowledge, Airy’s discoveries, the Old Dragon’s information and the Hermit Lizard’s bargain lead Zak toward Tka Rik (Tka-Lithan Richti-Nik). Along the way he becomes entangled in the village leaders’ plots and helps people whose interests often conflict. [3, 4, 5, 6, 7]

Ingos and Suslanger

The Great Magician offers help in exchange for finding two surviving Joons. On Ingos, Zak rescues Lu-a-Jalla, who has been imprisoned by Diera. His search for her beloved At-Zako then takes him to Suslanger, where he is captured, escapes with the Odalisque’s help and finds refuge among the Last Shelter’s brothers. A dead scientist’s testimony and the remains of a teleportation amulet become the decisive clues. [8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13]

At-Zako and the Curse

Tka Rik discovers that the amulet transported At-Zako to Gipath: Zak has been searching for himself. A Khadaganian scientist transformed the young Joon to hide him from the Joon Curse; the hurried spell also endangered his memory. Restored to his identity, At-Zako is reunited with Lu-a-Jalla. He chooses to confront the Curse with Tka Rik rather than spend their lives fleeing it. [14, 15, 16, 17]
